svg.title: AI-Based Telecom Incident Ticket Analyzer — Multi-Agent Architecture
svg.desc: LangGraph orchestration with four agents, ChromaDB RAG, human-in-the-loop checkpoint, memory layer, and monitoring.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How are telecom tickets ingested into the system?')
sendPrompt('What synthetic data does the system generate?')
sendPrompt('How does the ChromaDB RAG store work in this system?')
sendPrompt('What does the Ticket Classification Agent do?')
sendPrompt('How does the Severity Detection Agent score priority?')
sendPrompt('How does the Resolution Suggestion Agent use RAG to generate fixes?')
sendPrompt('What happens when a ticket is auto-approved?')
sendPrompt('How does the Human Approval Agent work in the HITL checkpoint?')
sendPrompt('What does the final ticket resolution output contain?')
sendPrompt('How does LangGraph manage memory and context across agents?')
sendPrompt('How does the retry and error handling work across agents?')
sendPrompt('How is LangSmith used for monitoring agent decisions?')
